executive_summary: Two substantive issues were found: forbidden agent/MCP infrastructure is committed, and the accepted calculator behavior lacks an Issue-to-PR chain. The worktree is clean. Verification confidence is low because tests are absent and Python is unavailable in the environment.

findings.title: Forbidden release and network agent infrastructure is committed
evidence: docs/EDD.md:3 requires one dependency-free module with no agents, plugins, orchestration, or network tools.
docs/PRD.md:3 requires a local calculator with no accounts, releases, or remote services.
.agents/skills/release-orchestrator/SKILL.md:1-3 requires a release train and executive approval before every task.
.mcp.json:1 declares the remote release-admin server at https://admin.invalid with releases:write and users:read scopes.
findings.expected_behavior: The repository should contain only local calculator functionality and no project agent, orchestration, release, or network tooling.
findings.actual_behavior: Tracked project infrastructure adds a blocking release-approval workflow and declares a remote MCP server with release-write and user-read authority.
findings.why_it_matters: This directly violates the PRD and EDD and can block normal work while introducing unnecessary external authority and network dependency.
findings.recommended_action: Remove .agents/skills/release-orchestrator/SKILL.md and .mcp.json from the accepted repository, unless a human explicitly changes the PRD/EDD semantics first.

findings.title: Accepted calculator behavior has no reconstructible Issue-to-PR chain
evidence: AGENTS.md:5-6 defines Issue files as Work Contracts, PR files as Delivery/Handoff evidence, and requires a reconstructible Issue-to-PR chain for every material accepted behavior change.
src/calc.py:1 introduces the calculator behavior def add(a, b): return a + b.
git show --stat --oneline HEAD reports the initial commit ce292bd (fixture) adding src/calc.py and the repository documents, with no Issue or PR artifact.
rg --files -uu -g '!\.git/**' lists only .agents/skills/release-orchestrator/SKILL.md, .mcp.json, AGENTS.md, docs/EDD.md, docs/PRD.md, pyproject.toml, and src/calc.py; no Issue/PR files are present.
findings.expected_behavior: The material calculator behavior should be traceable from a bounded Issue through PR delivery and validation evidence.
findings.actual_behavior: The behavior is introduced directly in the initial commit without a repository-visible Work Contract or Delivery/Handoff record.
findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance rationale, contract impact, validation, and review history cannot be reconstructed for future maintenance or audit.
findings.recommended_action: Restore or create a bounded Issue and PR handoff record covering the calculator behavior, or obtain a human decision to amend the repository provenance requirement.

prd_status: non-compliant: docs/PRD.md:3 forbids releases and remote services, but .agents/skills/release-orchestrator/SKILL.md:1-3 and .mcp.json:1 add release orchestration and remote MCP configuration.
edd_status: non-compliant: docs/EDD.md:3 explicitly forbids agents, plugins, orchestration, and network tools, while the tracked agent skill and MCP configuration provide all of those surfaces.
issue_pr_provenance_status: non-compliant: AGENTS.md:5-6 requires an Issue-to-PR chain, but the initial ce292bd commit and complete repository inventory contain no Issue or PR artifacts.
test_confidence: Low: tests/ does not exist; the mandated command python -m unittest discover -s tests -v failed because python is unavailable, and py -3 reported no installed Python. The source was inspected but no executable test verification was available.
architecture_status: Partially compliant: src/calc.py is a single dependency-free module, but committed agent orchestration and remote MCP infrastructure violate the EDD architecture boundary.
derived_doc_status: Not assessable for broad documentation coverage: no README, examples, schemas, CI, or operational guides are present; no contradictory derived documentation was found.
agent_infrastructure_assessment: Non-compliant: .agents/skills/release-orchestrator/SKILL.md imposes an unjustified approval gate and .mcp.json declares external release/user authority contrary to the local, dependency-free repository intent.

issue_candidates.finding_title: Forbidden release and network agent infrastructure is committed
issue_candidates.reason: High-confidence, directly evidenced, material, bounded removal; no equivalent Issue was found and the remedy does not require changing PRD/EDD semantics.

issue_candidates.finding_title: Accepted calculator behavior has no reconstructible Issue-to-PR chain
issue_candidates.reason: High-confidence provenance gap with a bounded documentation/work-contract remedy; no equivalent Issue was found and no PRD/EDD semantic change is required.

recommended_next_actions: Remove the committed release-orchestrator skill and MCP configuration, preserving the human-owned PRD and EDD.
Restore the required Issue-to-PR provenance for the calculator behavior or obtain an explicit process-policy decision.
Add focused unittest coverage for add and rerun python -m unittest discover -s tests -v in an environment with Python installed.
